api.note: API v1 alone does not establish review-v2 or private Web auth-status capability.

features.note: Both features are additive on review-v2 only. dense-128 raises the finding page from 32 to 128 and stays bounded by the 64 KiB body ceiling Core 0.10.0 serves, and reason-v1 adds a reason to each not_evaluated finding. A request without the header answers the published 32-finding, seven-key document; a header on review-v1, an unknown or repeated token, or an empty part is invalid_request, and a response that enabled a feature echoes the accepted set in the same header.

manuscript.note: v1 and v2 keep their meaning, and an imported v1 or v2 report, a document-mode choice or a semantic decision stays history, not a fresh check. v3 adds per-segment term results for long manuscripts: a saved segment result is reused only when its content hashes, review basis and request inputs all match a live review-v2 basis. v4 keeps v3's 13 top-level keys, the 44 MiB file limit and the canonical bytes, and raises the findings, resolutions and choices limits from 32 to 128 while allowing a reason on a not_evaluated finding; only the label v4 brings those limits, so a v1, v2 or v3 file keeps its 32-item caps and rejects reason. A writer stores the lowest format that holds the content (v1/v2, then v3, then v4). The v4 contract ships in Web 0.4.0, 0.4.1 and 0.4.2 and in Windows 0.6.0, 0.6.1 and 0.6.2, not in Web 0.3.1 or Windows 0.5.1, which reject a v4 file; the shipped-release records below keep the format each release was recorded with.

release.note: v0.11.0 is a dictionary and translation release on top of v0.10.3. The CJK matcher moves to wuwaterm-cjk-matcher-v9 (#300): a single-character CJK name is admitted only at a plausible right boundary, 有 joins the particle set so 椿有极其优秀的 is admitted while everyday 心 and ordinary compounds stay out, and translation reference admission and review-v2 consult the same helper, so stored v8 resolution contexts go stale and are re-reviewed. The pinned 3.7 data yields eight official dictionary rows it did not have before: the seven remaining multi-character Advertising_VersionTitle_30 to _36 release titles (37 was already curated), which runtime treats as contextual references on both sides and never as a forced substitution, and the derived item base 调谐器 / Tuner beside the speaker 调音师 / Tuner; because those are rows in the shipped dictionary, this release needs a full build-db rebuild, and a runtime-only update keeps the old database and changes none of it. Reference admission is occurrence-scoped (#300): retained pre-exclusion casefold collisions stay as model candidates, derived references (Area_<n>_Title, tier-base:<id>, soft-casing hints) are gated on natural-paragraph official term context, an admitted reference carries fail-closed model_start/model_end coordinates, and plain single-meaning requests keep byte-identical prompts. On zh->en a mixed single-character CJK proper name is locked selectively, so a character a longer global term already translates stays a scoped reference instead of reaching the prompt twice, and a surface that arrives as both a (speaker) entry and another kind of entry gets one disambiguating sentence, which fixes ordinary-en-zh reading the Tuner as 调音师; zh->en context requests ask for numeric qualifiers and trailing ellipses to survive translation, and the en->zh prompt is byte-identical (#300). WUWATERM_TRANSLATION_THINKING_EN_ZH gains an opt-in auto that resolves the mode per request: disabled at 4 or more locks or 25 or more paragraphs and low otherwise, one paragraph-count repair on a context-mode answer whose paragraph count differs from its source, and one shorter retry with thinking off after an auto timeout (#300). The production en->zh default stays omit and zh->en stays disabled (#302), so an unconfigured deployment sends the byte-identical provider-default request it sent before the setting existed; auto is a complete, tested opt-in, only auto may pick a different mode for a repair, and =omit remains the documented rollback. A segment now has at most one corrective call, so at most two model calls (#302): the low to disabled fallback under auto spends that call, a segment whose first attempt needed no fallback still gets its one repair, and an explicit mode still shores up its own request. Measured with auto explicitly opted in (WUWATERM_TRANSLATION_THINKING_EN_ZH=auto, q8r1 on c1bab1aa, 545 to 568 of 569, 23 POSTs, doubled-blind scoring at 95.9% judge agreement and 0/71 identical-output drift), D en-zh usable went 65/101 to 93/101 with 0 timeouts, D-009 went 0/30 usable to 28/30 at 3.7 s, the paired 65/71 usable with 6 critical errors held, D zh-en usable went 126/131 to 128/131, ordinary reached 12/12, and the 17-document D en-zh runtime went 221.4 s to 147.7 s; none of the en-zh numbers was measured under the shipped omit default, so they describe the opt-in and not an unconfigured deployment, and targeted R covered the 4 of 34 segments whose request changes while the full R set was not re-run and is not claimed. The model timeout (45 s), the request budget (90 s), segmentation-v1 (L = 1800), the OpenAPI and HTTP contracts and the product contracts are unchanged, the data pin stays 9218d612 (3.7.0 / 3.7.8 / 8975829), the Web and Windows pins stay at v0.10.3's, and H2 stays held-out used. release.note: v0.4.1 pins the published Core 0.10.1 wheel, whose SHA-256 0b38d3bcf40ee4658e2fdb4423eb5f99620e9d9262614224b5a737aa4cb0529d is the core_binding this bundle records, with core_source_commit dd238303 and the compatibility it declares exact (OCI index sha256:5c68d0d7e45ce67928ddb66c84a83cb75afbdd8b1faef2166c9363dad7768f63, manifest sha256:f94cf6fae5b79388f3c2578e476caa088df9e79604d161fb077163eed27b05c7, config sha256:501746ea792ad53e84116fdbd14e4fe2214f1c68f986e35ad0922389dbadd84e, built by image-bundle run 44697588205). It is a patch release on v0.4.0. The code change (#43) makes a failed shared-pointer send visible instead of silent: both send branches of _point_to_shared_result go through _notice_failed_delivery, so a reuser, including a waiter served the pointer after the same content was queued, receives the failure notice with its resend button while the job stays undelivered, and pressing it or submitting the same content again sends the stored report without another model call. Automatic retry narrows to a send that provably never left: _is_presend_network_error walks the cause chain and accepts only httpx.ConnectError and httpx.ProxyError, so ReadError, RemoteProtocolError, WriteError, a bare NetworkError, BadRequest, Forbidden and TimedOut are not retried, and no retry happens once any chunk has reached the chat. The failure notice splits by outcome: the existing notice says the result was not delivered, and a new uncertain notice says Telegram may have received it and a resend may duplicate, which is the path a ConnectTimeout takes because python-telegram-bot 22.8 raises TimedOut for it rather than NetworkError. Seven test cases cover the two files. The release-prep change (#44) is the Core pin, the package metadata and the docs that describe it, and the tag push produced no duplicate CI run: the only run on this commit that the tag started is the release run itself.
